task_meta.title: Improve an ugly, inaccessible signup form

judge.reasons: Calm centred card, visible labels, hint text, dominant full-width button, fits 390px with ~48px inputs. Error, submitting and success states and the a11y wiring aren't shown in the screenshots, so they can't be confirmed.

digest: Read 9 files (1 before its first edit), made 7 edits, ran tests 9 times; re-ran them after its last edit.
